items.headline: Manchester United Women lose 5-0 to Chelsea in WSL; Eva Olid's new era off to difficult start
items.summary: United Women were defeated 5-0 by Chelsea with goals from Nusken, Walsh, James, Carpenter and Bronze. Manager Eva Olid overseeing the team.

items.headline: Manchester derby set for Old Trafford; Carrick names team with several injury concerns
items.summary: Michael Carrick has named the squad for the upcoming Manchester derby against City at Old Trafford with multiple players unavailable.

items.headline: Benjamin Sesko discusses injury recovery and summer fitness preparation
items.summary: Sesko has spoken about his recovery from injury and changes made to his fitness routine during the summer.
